tere: tere — that, that one; also 'he, she' (demonstrative and third-person pronoun; plural tede) [那般] · also with Ming 那 ('that'), before a noun: tere deleme üge
ülü-ü: ülü — not; followed by -ü, a particle of question (uncertain; the Ming puts its 麽 on the next word) (negative particle + particle) [不]
büleġe: bü- — to be; past büleġe, 'there was, used to be' [有來]
keġeġed: keġe- — to say; converb -ġed, 'having said' (verb, converb) [說了]
üküġülün: ükü- — to die; causative -ġül-, 'make die, put to death'; converb -n, 'putting to death' (verb, causative converb) [敎死]
quildar-un: Quildar — Quildar, a man's name, perhaps the Qujuldar of the earlier parts (uncertain); genitive -un, 'Quildar's' (personal name + case; Ming 人名的) [人名的]
amin-u: amin — life; -u: genitive: of (back-vowel form) [性命 的]
tula: tula — because of, on account of (postposition; the Ming 上頭 'on top of', hence 'for that reason') [上頭]
žaγ̇un: žaγ̇un — hundred (numeral; the Ming 百 is bracketed) [(百)]
žirgin-i: Žirgin — the Jirgin, a people; accusative -i, 'the Jirgin (object)' (people name + case; Ming 姓(名)行) [姓(名)行]
köġün-e: köġün — son; dative-locative -e, 'to (my) son' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [子行]
ögtügei: ög- — to give; optative -tügei, 'let him give, let it be given' (verb, optative, third person, front-vowel form) [與者︀]
uruγ-un: uruγ — offspring, descendants, lineage; genitive -un, 'of the lineage' (noun + case; Ming 子子) [子子]
uruγ-a: uruγ-a — as kin, to the kin (uruγ 'kin, relatives, offspring' + dative -a) [親戚行] · also 'to the offspring' (Ming 子孫行), as in Uruγ-un uruγ-a kürtele 'down to the offspring of the offspring'
kürtele: kür- — to reach; -tele, 'until, up to' (verb, terminal converb) [到了]
daγažu: daγa- — to follow; converb -žu, 'following' (verb, converb) [隨着]
an-u: an-u — their (back-vowel companion of in-ü, third-person genitive placed after its noun) [他的]
öġer-ün: öġer — own, self; genitive -ün after r (pronoun + case) [自己(的)]
köġün-ü: köġün — son; genitive -ü after n, 'of the son' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [兒子 的]
emüne: emüne — front, before, in front of (adverb or noun) [前行]
bolba: bol- — to become; past -ba, 'became' (verb, past tense) [做了]
aman: aman — mouth, muzzle (noun) [口] · also 'oath, vow' (Ming 盟 'covenant'), compare aman aldaž- 'to swear'
urida: urida — formerly, before, in front (adverb) [在前]
tusa-jin: tusa — benefit, favour; genitive -jin, 'of' (after a vowel) (noun + case) [恩的]
abun: ab- — to take; converb -un, 'taking' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [要]
atuγai: a- — to be, remain; optative -tuγai, 'let it be, let it stay' (verb, optative, third person) [存着]
